about: SkillNavora price list. Every PDF, workbook, dataset and interactive handbook is locked when the PAYWALL setting is on. A file belongs to the FIRST product whose 'files' pattern matches it. Patterns are paths from the site root: * matches within one folder, ** matches across folders. Prices: inr_list is the USD price x 100; inr is what the buyer pays after the discount. Change prices here only.
